groups.name: Fully rounded pill primary buttons
groups.definition: Are the primary calls to action fully rounded pill-shaped buttons?

groups.name: Rectangular or modest-radius buttons
groups.definition: Are the buttons rectangular or only modestly rounded (about 4-8px) rather than pills?

groups.name: Filled primary paired with outlined secondary
groups.definition: Does the page pair a filled primary button with an outlined secondary button?

groups.name: Widespread rounded corners on cards
groups.definition: Are rounded corners (8px or more) used widely across cards, tiles and inputs?

groups.name: Cards with accent left border
groups.definition: Do cards or notices have a colored left border accent?

groups.name: Minimal newsletter signup form
groups.definition: Is the newsletter signup a minimal single-email-input form with one button?

groups.name: Social links as plain text
groups.definition: Are social links plain text labels or a single link without icon graphics?

groups.name: Social icons in circles or outlined pills
groups.definition: Are social links shown as outlined circular badges or outlined button tiles?

groups.name: Payment method badges
groups.definition: Does the page show a row of payment-method logos or badges (or explicitly omit them)?

groups.name: Translucent blurred header
groups.definition: Is the header translucent with backdrop blur?

groups.name: Full-width announcement strip
groups.definition: Is there a thin full-width colored announcement or promo strip?

groups.name: Dark utility bar above nav
groups.definition: Is there a compact utility bar with text links above the main navigation?

groups.name: Arrow-suffixed text links
groups.definition: Do links or tiles end with an arrow glyph or arrow accent?

groups.name: Text-only cards without images
groups.definition: Are content cards text-only with no images?

groups.name: Statistics as separate cards
groups.definition: Are statistics shown as separate cards or columns with large numerals?

groups.name: Outlined pill chips as links
groups.definition: Are category or suggestion links styled as small pill chips?

groups.name: Small pill badges and labels
groups.definition: Are badges or labels small accent-colored pills?

groups.name: Dark footer with logo
groups.definition: Is the footer a dark band repeating the white logo?

groups.name: Minimal footer
groups.definition: Is the footer slim and minimal with little content?

groups.name: Compact header with logo and text links
groups.definition: Is the header a compact single-row bar with small logo and plain text links?

groups.name: Navigation without dropdown carets
groups.definition: Are navigation labels plain without dropdown carets or chevrons?

groups.name: Search or select bar near hero
groups.definition: Is there a dedicated search or select bar in or beneath the hero?

groups.name: Carousel and pagination indicators
groups.definition: Are carousel or pagination controls shown as styled dots or circles with active state?

groups.name: Hero or promo in solid color panel
groups.definition: Is the hero or promo a solid or gradient colored panel with large white heading?

groups.name: Equal bordered card grids
groups.definition: Are items shown as equal-sized bordered cards in a grid or row?

groups.name: Hairline dividers between list items
groups.definition: Are list rows separated by thin rules or dividers?

groups.name: Text wordmark logo
groups.definition: Is the site name a text wordmark rather than an image logo?

groups.name: Logos on light rounded plates
groups.definition: Are partner, sponsor or certification logos set on light rounded tiles?

groups.name: Simple contact or form controls
groups.definition: Does the page use simple forms with few native controls and clear labels?

groups.name: Solid accent color info block
groups.definition: Is key info or quick links placed in a solid accent-colored block or band?

groups.name: Underlined centered secondary link
groups.definition: Is a secondary link underlined and centered under the main button?

groups.name: Section heading decoration
groups.definition: Do section headings carry accent underlines, rules or a view-all link?

groups.name: Italic serif item strip
groups.definition: Are item titles shown in an italic serif strip with bullets?

groups.name: Image gradient overlay cards
groups.definition: Do cards have text over a darkening gradient overlay?

groups.name: Event dates on news items
groups.definition: Does every news item show a date?

groups.name: Plain text featured tag
groups.definition: Is the featured tag a plain colored text label rather than a filled badge?

groups.name: Back-to-top control
groups.definition: Is there a pill-styled back-to-top control?

groups.name: Compact promo banners
groups.definition: Are secondary promos compact horizontal banners with thumbnails?

groups.name: Circular initials avatars
groups.definition: Are avatars circular initials rather than photos?

groups.name: Social login sign-up panel
groups.definition: Is there a dedicated sign-up panel with social login buttons?

groups.name: Few icon glyphs
groups.definition: Does the interface avoid icon glyphs and rely on text labels?

groups.name: RSS link with icon and label
groups.definition: Is the RSS link a small icon with an explicit text label?

groups.name: Hero translucent value cards
groups.definition: Does the hero show a row of translucent value-proposition cards with check icons?

groups.name: Calendar and footer link cards
groups.definition: Does the page use rounded card calendars or footer link groups in bordered cards?

groups.name: Nav links light over hero photo
groups.definition: Are nav links light-weight white text over the hero photo with no active state?
